assumptions.sentence: When we train the RNN Encoder--Decoder, we ignore the (normalized) frequencies of each phrase pair in the original corpora.
assumptions.anchorText: When we train the RNN Encoder--Decoder, we ignore the (normalized) frequencies of each phrase pair in the original corpora.
assumptions.section: Scoring Phrase Pairs with RNN Encoder--Decoder

assumptions.sentence: Since the existing translation model relies solely on the statistics of the phrase pairs in the corpus, we expect its scores to be better estimated for the frequent phrases but badly estimated for rare phrases.
assumptions.anchorText: Since the existing translation model relies solely on the statistics of the phrase pairs in the corpus, we expect its scores to be better estimated for the frequent phrases but badly estimated for rare phrases.

assumptions.sentence: We focus on those pairs whose source phrase is long (more than 3 words per source phrase) and frequent.
assumptions.anchorText: We focus on those pairs whose source phrase is long (more than 3 words per source phrase) and frequent.

assumptions.sentence: Since the proposed RNN Encoder--Decoder also projects to and maps back from a sequence of words into a continuous space vector, we expect to see a similar property with the proposed model as well.
assumptions.anchorText: Since the proposed RNN Encoder--Decoder also projects to and maps back from a sequence of words into a continuous space vector, we expect to see a similar property with the proposed model as well.
